answer: The distribution of the RNA expression data is highly right skewed (pooled skewness ≈ +42 on the raw as-supplied scale; extremely heavy right tail, e.g., median 177 vs max 1.34e6, 15.2% zeros). Context: the right skew is an artifact of the raw count scale — log2(x+1) transformation yields an approximately normal distribution (skew ≈ −0.30), which is why log transformation is standard before downstream analyses.
